sections.h2: Where is Goose Creek, SC, and who are its neighbors?
sections.html:
Goose Creek is the most populous city in Berkeley County, in the southern part of the county and inside the Charleston-North Charleston metro area. It sits at only 13 feet of elevation. The Cooper River and Back River form its eastern edge, Hanahan lies to the southwest, North Charleston is farther west, and the unincorporated community of Ladson is to the west.

The city covers 42.84 square miles, of which about half a square mile is water. It was incorporated in 1961 and has added residents in every census since. The table shows how fast.

Census yearGoose Creek population

The 2020 count made Goose Creek the seventh most populous city in South Carolina. It had 16,298 households and a median age of 33.1. Figures are from the city's Wikipedia entry.

sections.h2: What is the history behind the Goose Creek name?
sections.html:
The name comes from a creek that feeds the Cooper River. In the 1670s the Etiwan moved to this area to escape the Westo and sought protection near colonial plantations. Early colonists known as the Goose Creek men settled here and led the early Indian trade, first in Indian slaves and later in deerskins.

Two sites are on the National Register of Historic Places: the Otranto Plantation Indigo Vats and St. James Church. The modern city is much younger. Most of what a buyer sees is the product of the growth that followed the city's 1961 incorporation.

sections.h2: How does Joint Base Charleston shape the Goose Creek housing market?
sections.html:
The military is the largest single presence. Joint Base Charleston formed in 2010 when the Air Force base merged with the Naval Weapons Station. The city's entry calls the military its dominant economic presence. The installation's official site says the 628th Air Base Wing supports more than 60 Defense Department and federal agencies, and its protocol office lists 53 tenant units. The 437th Airlift Wing flies 40 C-17A aircraft, and the wing says it serves more than 90,000 service members, civilians, dependents and retirees.

Tenants named in the city's entry include:

  • Naval Information Warfare Center Atlantic
  • Nuclear Power School
  • Naval Health Clinic Charleston
  • The South Carolina Army National Guard
  • The 315th and 437th Airlift Wings
  • The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers

A homeowner who gets orders can end up leaving before the house sells. The practical question then is who handles repairs, showings and utilities while you are away.

sections.h2: What are the schools and services in Goose Creek?
sections.html:
Public schools belong to the Berkeley County School District, whose office is at 107 East Main Street in Moncks Corner, phone 843-899-8600. Goose Creek High School and Stratford High School are inside city limits, and Cane Bay High School is outside the limits but serves students from both inside and outside.

Goose Creek has a branch of the Berkeley County Library System. The city's police department works from the Marguerite H. Brown Municipal Center, which also houses City Hall and Municipal Court. Buyers who ask about a specific school zone should get the answer from the district, because zones can change with growth.

sections.h2: What do hurricanes and flooding mean for a Goose Creek house?
sections.html:
Goose Creek sits at 13 feet of elevation next to the Cooper and Back rivers, so insurance is a fair first question for any buyer. Berkeley County Emergency Management says most homeowner, mobile home and rental policies do not include flood coverage, which has to be bought separately. A flood policy carries a 30-day waiting period, and wind and hail coverage can carry a 15-day wait.

The county also notes that you cannot buy homeowner's or renter's insurance after a hurricane watch or warning has been issued. For a seller, that means a buyer who is under contract during hurricane season may have a hard time adding coverage late in the process.

  • Pull your current homeowner's and flood policies and have the declarations pages ready.
  • Gather roof and window replacement dates for the buyer's insurance agent.
  • Keep records of any past water entry and what was repaired.
  • Check whether a flood policy is in force and transferable.

We could not confirm flood zone or evacuation zone data for specific Goose Creek streets from an official page, so ask Berkeley County Emergency Management at 843-719-4166 about your address.

sections.h2: How are Berkeley County property taxes billed in Goose Creek?
sections.html:
Berkeley County bills real estate tax once a year, and payment is made to the Tax Collector in Moncks Corner. The county's auditor page explains the math: market value times the assessment ratio gives assessed value, and assessed value times the millage rate gives the tax. Reassessment is a state-required process, usually every five years.

DateWhat it means
October 1Property tax books open
January 15Prior year's taxes due
January 16 to February 13 percent penalty
February 2 to March 16Additional 7 percent penalty

The county's real property page says it issued assessment notices on May 22, 2025, with appeals due July 31, and that the deadline for the 4 percent legal residence credit was January 15, 2026. The county does not list the ratio on its auditor page, so use the state figures: 4 percent for a qualifying primary home, 6 percent for other real property.

If you rent out a Goose Creek house you used to live in, ask the county whether the 4 percent status still applies before you assume the bill will stay the same.

sections.h2: What permit and code rules apply in Goose Creek?
sections.html:
The City of Goose Creek handles permits through an online portal and enforces zoning, property maintenance and nuisance ordinances. Its main line is 843-797-6220, and city mail goes to 519 N. Goose Creek Boulevard, PO Drawer 1768, Goose Creek, SC 29445.

According to the city's residential permit page, these jobs get standard review:

  • Re-roofing and roof repairs
  • Water heater and HVAC equipment change-outs
  • Replacement windows and vinyl siding
  • Electrical upgrades and gas furnace change-outs
  • Minor non-structural wood rot repairs

Additions, structural repairs, landscaping, new construction, and accessory structures of 200 square feet or more need review by both Planning and Zoning and the building office, which takes longer. The city also publishes a Certificate of Occupancy versus Completion guide.

If a prior owner replaced a roof or water heater, confirm the permit was closed. The Code Enforcement Division covers property maintenance on all properties in the city, so a vacant house with overgrowth can draw a notice. The page we read does not describe fines or time limits, so call the division.

sections.h2: How does a Goose Creek sale close under South Carolina law?
sections.html:
A South Carolina attorney runs the closing, and the deed is recorded with the Berkeley County Register of Deeds. The county says land records are available in the office back to 1884, and the South Carolina court system lists the office at PO Box 6122, Moncks Corner, phone 843-719-4084.

The state deed recording fee is $1.85 for the first $500 of value plus $1.30 for each additional $500, according to the Department of Revenue. The seller must also deliver a written property condition disclosure before a contract is signed, unless the sale is exempt, and must correct it or make repairs if something material changes before closing.

faqs.q: Is Goose Creek in Berkeley County or Charleston County?
faqs.a: Goose Creek is in southern Berkeley County and is the county's most populous city. It is part of the Charleston-North Charleston metropolitan area, and its tax bill and deed recording go through Berkeley County offices.

faqs.q: When are Goose Creek property taxes due?
faqs.a: Taxes for a given year are payable by January 15 of the following year. A 3 percent penalty applies from January 16 to February 1, and an additional 7 percent applies from February 2 to March 16, according to Berkeley County.

faqs.q: Does a flood policy take effect right away?
faqs.a: No. Berkeley County Emergency Management says flood policies have a 30-day waiting period and wind and hail coverage can have a 15-day wait. Coverage also cannot be bought after a hurricane watch or warning is issued.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit to replace a roof in Goose Creek?
faqs.a: The city lists re-roofing and roof repairs among the permits that receive standard review. Apply through the city's online permitting portal or call 843-797-6220 to check.

faqs.q: Can I sell my Goose Creek house if I am being transferred?
faqs.a: Yes, a sale is possible. The closing is run by a South Carolina attorney, so ask that attorney how signing from out of town can be arranged.
